pairs: The fool has said in his heart,
et abominabiles facti sunt in studiis suis;
and they have become abominable in their studies.
There is no one who does good;
Dominus de cælo prospexit super filios hominum,
The Lord has looked down from heaven upon the sons of men,
to see if there were any who were considering
There is no one who does good;
Their throat is an open sepulcher.
the venom of asps is under their lips.
Their mouth is full of curses and bitterness.
veloces pedes eorum ad effundendum sanguinem.
Their feet are swift to shed blood.
Grief and unhappiness are in their ways;
non est timor Dei ante oculos eorum.
There is no fear of God before their eyes.
Nonne cognoscent omnes qui operantur iniquitatem,
Will they never learn: all those who work iniquity,
qui devorant plebem meam sicut escam panis?
who devour my people like a meal of bread?
They have not called upon the Lord.
There, they have trembled in fear,
Quoniam Dominus in generatione justa est:
For the Lord is with the just generation.
consilium inopis confudistis, quoniam Dominus spes ejus est.
You have confounded the counsel of the needy because the Lord is his hope.
Quis dabit ex Sion salutare Israël?
Who will grant the salvation of Israel from Zion?
Cum averterit Dominus captivitatem plebis suæ,
When the Lord turns away the captivity of his people,
